name: folio-capture
description: Read local Folio screenshots and submit scoped quality and taxonomy judgments through the connected chat model. No Codex or API inference calls.

interface.longDescription: Review saved Folio screenshots in ChatGPT Desktop. Start Folio's local HTTP bridge, then request its status and process its review queue. The launcher uses no Codex or model API.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check Folio's status, then process its saved review queue. Inspect all supplied images and submit valid judgments. Keep replies brief.
